title: Blaze: The Passion Run 2027 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Blaze: The Passion Run Clark Review: 2025 Results and Weather
meta_description: Blaze: The Passion Run review from the 2025 race at Filinvest Mimosa+ in Clark: 25°C and 83% humidity before dawn, 146 half-marathon finishers with a 2:23 median, and what the 2027 entry includes.
dek: What JCIR Events' Clark race was like in November 2025, then run as Great Run Clark: the pre-dawn weather and how fast its small half-marathon and 10 km fields ran.
verdict: Enter if you want a small, low-key half marathon in Clark where nobody will rush you. The 2025 race had 146 half-marathon finishers and 203 in the 10 km, and half of the half marathoners took longer than 2:23. Clark airport recorded a mild 25°C and 83% humidity through the early morning, warming to 27°C by 8am. Almost nothing was published about the course or the cut-offs, so ask the organiser before you sign up.

sections.heading: The 2025 Race
paragraphs: JCIR Events Management ran the 2025 edition on Sunday 23 November as Great Run Clark: Blaze: The Passion Run, at Filinvest Mimosa+ in Clark, with a 21 km, a 10 km and a 5 km [1]. No route map, gun times or cut-offs were published for it; the results system records the event at 4am [1].

sections.heading: The Weather: Mild Until Sunrise
paragraphs: Clark International Airport, a short drive from Mimosa+, recorded 25°C, a 22°C dew point, 83% humidity and a 4-knot wind every hour from 2am to 6am on race morning [3]. It warmed to 26°C at 7am, 27°C at 8am and 28°C at 9am [3]. For the Philippines that is kind running air: a median half marathoner starting before 5am would have finished before it passed 27°C.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: Small and mixed. The half marathon had 146 finishers. It was won in 1:19:20 by a man and 1:43:32 by a woman; tenth place was 1:41:31, the median 2:23:24 and the slowest tenth took more than 3:04 [4]. A quarter broke two hours and 57% broke 2:30, and 34% of finishers were women [4].

The 10 km had 203 finishers, won in 39:09 and 53:12, with tenth place at 48:33, a median of 1:24:14, 18% under an hour and 47% women [4]. With fields this size, a two-hour half marathoner finishes in the top quarter.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a quiet half marathon at Clark with mild pre-dawn air and a slow, friendly field.
Think twice if you need a published route, cut-offs and aid plan before you commit: for 2025 there were none.

The next race is listed for Sunday 10 January 2027 at Filinvest Mimosa+, with a 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [2]. The same listing also mentions a 22 November date, so confirm it with the organiser. Fees rise from PHP 1,750 to PHP 2,200 for the 21 km across three price tiers, and every entry includes a singlet, medal, string bag and chip-timed bib, with a finisher shirt for the 10 km and 21 km [2].
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the results, an event listing and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast is the Blaze: The Passion Run half marathon?
faqs.answer: Relaxed. At the 2025 race, 146 runners finished the 21 km with a median of 2:23:24; a quarter broke two hours and the slowest tenth took more than 3:04. It was won in 1:19:20 by a man and 1:43:32 by a woman, and tenth place was 1:41:31.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at Blaze: The Passion Run in Clark?
faqs.answer: Mild before sunrise. On race morning in 2025 Clark airport recorded 25°C, 83% humidity and a light wind from 2am to 6am. It reached 26°C at 7am, 27°C at 8am and 28°C at 9am, so most half marathoners finished before the heat built.

faqs.question: When is the next Blaze: The Passion Run?
faqs.answer: The event listing gives Sunday 10 January 2027 at Filinvest Mimosa+ in Clark, with 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, although the same page also mentions a 22 November date. Confirm the date with JCIR Events before booking travel. The 2025 edition was held on 23 November.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the 2025 edition (Great Run Clark: Blaze: The Passion Run, Sunday 23 November 2025), the only edition for which we hold results. Evidence beyond the results is very thin: the MyRunTime results and registration pages render only in a browser, so the event name, venue and categories are from the results page's own data feed; no route, gun times, cut-offs, aid plan, news report or runner account was found, and the organiser's Facebook page could not be read. The 2025 race also had a 5 km, which is not in our finish-time data. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official results. Weather is from Clark airport METAR; the 4am event time in the results system is not labelled a gun time. The next-edition listing contradicts itself on the date (10 January 2027 and 22 November); both are given. An unverified 7am cut-off on the entity record was not confirmed by any page opened and is not used. No rating.
